notes: VAT: the supply of precious metals and of jewellery made from them is EXEMPT (Tax Code art. 251(3)) - gold and silver, both forms, coded 0. General VAT is 14% for 2024-2026 (art. 397(4); statutory 15%, 13% from 2027). Caveats: andoz.tj text is the Tax Committees own unofficial English translation; art. 251(4) exempts precious-metal imports only by the National Bank/MoF. Duty null.

sources.name: Tax Committee under the Government of the Republic of Tajikistan (andoz.tj) - Tax Code, consolidated text as amended 14 May 2025, art. 251(3)
sources.what: Read 2026-11-28: the supply of precious metals and jewellery made of precious metals and precious stones is exempt from VAT
sources.quote: Supply, precious metals and precious stones, jewelry made of precious metals and precious stones, primary aluminum, concentrates of natural resources, commercial ore, scrap of ferrous and non-ferrous metals and other metals produced in the Republic of Tajikistan, precious metal ingots of the National Bank of Tajikistan
